scope: First quadruped compatibility milestone after the qualified humanoid vertical slice

acceptance.anatomy: Every fixture resolves to family=quadruped and schema=quadruped_v1 before humanoid Rigify detection
acceptance.roles: Pelvis, chest, head, and four upper/lower/foot/toe limb chains resolve without missing required roles
acceptance.controls: Captured controls exclude DEF, MCH, ORG, VIS and tweak/mechanism bones
acceptance.workflow: Generated cat, horse and wolf complete two-anchor capture, nine-frame pose blending, candidate review and discard
acceptance.source_safety: Original action curves and source selection remain byte-equivalent through preview and discard
acceptance.fail_closed: Humanoid assisted pose, whole-body, contact, flight and learned temporal entry paths do not mutate a quadruped rig
acceptance.regression: All 49 established source suites plus the quadruped suite pass with one runtime hash set

qualified: Rigify cat, horse and wolf recognition
Generic pose capture and pose-blending interpolation on generated fixtures
Explicit UI and runtime boundary around humanoid-only solvers
not_qualified: Quadruped learned posing or learned motion

network: No downloads, provider calls or outbound runtime calls are permitted
